title: handpicked — happen

translations.translation: 偏心挑选的，精心挑选出来的；用手挑选的
用手采摘；仔细挑选（handpick的过去分词）

sentences.sentence: one of his handpicked advisers
sentences.translation: 他精挑细选的顾问之一

sentences.sentence: He greeted me with a handshake and a glass of wine.
sentences.translation: 他与我握手问候，并递给我一杯酒。

sentences.sentence: Her handshake was warm and firm.
sentences.translation: 她的握手温暖而有力。

translations.translation: （男子）英俊的；可观的；大方的，慷慨的；健美而端庄的

sentences.sentence: He managed to make a handsome profit out of the deal.
sentences.translation: 他从这笔买卖中赚取了丰厚的利润。

sentences.sentence: a handsome fee
sentences.translation: 一大笔费用

translations.translation: 漂亮地；慷慨地；相当大地

sentences.sentence: When I was just about nine or ten years old, I could hold a headstand for five minutes, and I could kick up against the wall and go into a handstand.
sentences.translation: 在九岁左右，我就能够头触地倒立五分钟，还能够借助墙壁完全用手倒立。

sentences.sentence: A five-minute handstand is one of the hardships that teaches martial arts novices to "eat bitterness." Teachers emphasize character, kung fu, and academics, with a little free time for basketball.
sentences.translation: 五分钟的手倒立是教练要求初学者必做的“吃苦”项目之一，教练会在篮球活动的间隙强调品行、功夫和教学之间的联系。

sentences.sentence: I caught her ankles as she kicked into a handstand.
sentences.translation: 她倒立踢腾腿时，我抓稳她的脚踝。

sentences.sentence: I recognised her handwriting on the envelope.
sentences.translation: 我认出了信封上她的笔迹。

sentences.sentence: My handwriting has never been very neat.
sentences.translation: 我的字从来都写得不够工整。

translations.translation: 便利的；手边的，就近的；容易取得的；敏捷的

sentences.sentence: I always keep my gun handy just in case.
sentences.translation: 我总是随身带着枪以防万一。

sentences.sentence: Do you have a piece of paper handy?
sentences.translation: 你手边有纸吗？

translations.translation: 手巧的人；[劳经] 杂务工；水手
悬挂，垂下；装饰；绞死；使悬而未决

符合，一致；同心协力；结合在一起
依附；继续保留；紧紧抓住

sentences.sentence: If he is found guilty, he will almost certainly hang.
sentences.translation: 如果被判有罪，他几乎肯定会被处以绞刑。

sentences.sentence: Walls on either side of the structure, making it resemble an aircraft hangar, will help isolate debris.
sentences.translation: 与飞机库相似，这座建筑的墙在其两端。这两面墙会帮助隔离废墟。

sentences.sentence: Senator McCain and the former president came together in a hangar at Houston's Hobby airport and stood side by side with their wives as the 41st president offered his endorsement.
sentences.translation: 参议员麦凯恩和前总统布什携他们的妻子一起出现在休斯敦机场的一个飞机库中。 第41届总统宣布他将支持麦克恩选举。

phrases.translation: 挂衣服的架子；衣架（等于coat hanger）

sentences.sentence: She took off her jacket and hung it on a hanger.
sentences.translation: 她脱下夹克挂在衣架上。

translations.translation: 门帘；脚手架；帘布（hanging的复数）

phrases.translation: 空中花园（古巴比伦王国的世界七大奇观之一）

translations.translation: 刽子手；绞刑吏；执行绞刑者
手指头的倒拉刺（指甲旁的逆刺皮）

sentences.sentence: It's an environment that is at once trashy and highly exacting: every hangnail a sin, every eye-bag a crime.
sentences.translation: 环境就是这样的严格：每个手指倒刺都是过失，每个眼袋都是罪恶。

sentences.sentence: I had a terrible hangover the next day.
sentences.translation: 第二天我的宿醉反应很厉害。

sentences.sentence: I hankered after a floor-length brown suede coat.
sentences.translation: 我渴望一件垂地长度的棕色麂皮大衣。

sentences.sentence: The Operatic Bow Same as above, only with a giant hankie in your right hand to wipe the sweat off your forehead after the exertion of returning to the vertical.
sentences.translation: 同上，只不过右手拿一个大手帕，努力站直的时候好擦前额的汗。 （译注：演完歌剧后要长时间谢幕。）

sentences.sentence: Some try their best to comfort you, hand you a tissue or hankie, trying to soothe you with some soft words. But then there are some who will hold you and hug you.
sentences.translation: 一引起人尽量地安慰你，递给你一张纸巾或一块手帕，并且尽量和你说些宽慰的话。

sentences.sentence: Is this mama's hankie?
sentences.translation: 这是妈妈的手帕吗？

translations.translation: 偶然的；随便的；无计划的

sentences.sentence: Educational provision in the country is haphazard.
sentences.translation: 该国提供的教育毫无计划性。

sentences.sentence: The hapless passengers were stranded at the airport for three days.
sentences.translation: 倒霉的乘客在机场滞留了三天。

sentences.sentence: When did the accident happen?
sentences.translation: 事故什么时候发生的？

sentences.sentence: It’s impossible to predict what will happen next.
sentences.translation: 不可能预测接下来会发生什么。

sentences.sentence: She carried on as if nothing had happened.
sentences.translation: 她继续干，似乎什么都未曾发生。

sentences.sentence: This was bound to happen sooner or later.
sentences.translation: 这事注定早晚会发生。

sentences.sentence: This kind of thing happens all the time.
sentences.translation: 这种事一直在发生。

sentences.sentence: We’ll still be friends, whatever happens.
sentences.translation: 不管发生什么，我们仍然是朋友。

text:
英语词汇 · 专八 · 第 287 单元

handpicked
音标：英 /'hænd'pɪkt/  美 /'hænd'pikt/
adj. 偏心挑选的，精心挑选出来的；用手挑选的
v. 用手采摘；仔细挑选（handpick的过去分词）
例句：one of his handpicked advisers
他精挑细选的顾问之一

handshake
音标：英 /'hæn(d)ʃeɪk/  美 /'hænd'ʃek/
n. 握手
例句：He greeted me with a handshake and a glass of wine.
他与我握手问候，并递给我一杯酒。
例句：Her handshake was warm and firm.
她的握手温暖而有力。

handsome
音标：英 /'hæns(ə)m/  美 /'hænsəm/
adj. （男子）英俊的；可观的；大方的，慷慨的；健美而端庄的
短语：handsome boy — 帅小伙
短语：handsome salary — 可观的薪水
例句：He managed to make a handsome profit out of the deal.
他从这笔买卖中赚取了丰厚的利润。
例句：a handsome fee
一大笔费用

handsomely
adv. 漂亮地；慷慨地；相当大地

handstand
音标：英 /'hæn(d)stænd/  美 /'hændstænd/
n. 手倒立
例句：When I was just about nine or ten years old, I could hold a headstand for five minutes, and I could kick up against the wall and go into a handstand.
在九岁左右，我就能够头触地倒立五分钟，还能够借助墙壁完全用手倒立。
例句：A five-minute handstand is one of the hardships that teaches martial arts novices to "eat bitterness." Teachers emphasize character, kung fu, and academics, with a little free time for basketball.
五分钟的手倒立是教练要求初学者必做的“吃苦”项目之一，教练会在篮球活动的间隙强调品行、功夫和教学之间的联系。
例句：I caught her ankles as she kicked into a handstand.
她倒立踢腾腿时，我抓稳她的脚踝。

handwriting
音标：英 /'hændraɪtɪŋ/  美 /'hænd'raɪtɪŋ/
n. 笔迹；书法；书写；手稿
v. 亲手写（handwrite的ing形式）
短语：handwriting recognition — 手写识别
例句：I recognised her handwriting on the envelope.
我认出了信封上她的笔迹。
例句：My handwriting has never been very neat.
我的字从来都写得不够工整。

handy
音标：英 /'hændɪ/  美 /'hændi/
adj. 便利的；手边的，就近的；容易取得的；敏捷的
n. (Handy)人名；(英)汉迪
短语：come in handy — 迟早有用
例句：I always keep my gun handy just in case.
我总是随身带着枪以防万一。
例句：Do you have a piece of paper handy?
你手边有纸吗？

handyman
音标：英 /'hændɪmæn/  美 /'hændɪmæn/
n. 手巧的人；[劳经] 杂务工；水手

hang
音标：英 /hæŋ/  美 /hæŋ/
v. 悬挂，垂下；装饰；绞死；使悬而未决
n. 悬挂；暂停，中止
短语：hang on — 坚持下去；不挂断；握住不放
短语：hang out — 挂出；闲逛
短语：hang up — 挂断电话；搁置，拖延
短语：get the hang of — 得知……的窍门；熟悉某物的用法；理解某事，摸清概况；鉴赏
短语：hang seng — 香港恒生股票指数；香港恒生银行
短语：hang out with — 与…出去玩；与…闲逛
短语：hang around — 闲荡；徘徊
短语：go hang — 不再关心；被忘却
短语：hang in there — [口]坚持下去
短语：hang seng index — 恒生指数
短语：hang together — 符合，一致；同心协力；结合在一起
短语：hang loose — ◎悬空，摇晃
短语：hang over — 笼罩；威胁；被遗留下
短语：hang seng bank — 恒生银行
短语：hang down — [美俚]阴茎
短语：hang from — 从…悬挂
短语：hang in the balance — 安危未定
短语：hang onto — 依附；继续保留；紧紧抓住
短语：hang around with — （和某人）厮混；（在某处）闲荡
短语：hang fire — 发射不出；迟疑不决
例句：If he is found guilty, he will almost certainly hang.
如果被判有罪，他几乎肯定会被处以绞刑。

hangar
音标：英 /'hæŋə/  美 /'hæŋɚ/
n. 飞机库；飞机棚
例句：Walls on either side of the structure, making it resemble an aircraft hangar, will help isolate debris.
与飞机库相似，这座建筑的墙在其两端。这两面墙会帮助隔离废墟。
例句：Senator McCain and the former president came together in a hangar at Houston's Hobby airport and stood side by side with their wives as the 41st president offered his endorsement.
参议员麦凯恩和前总统布什携他们的妻子一起出现在休斯敦机场的一个飞机库中。 第41届总统宣布他将支持麦克恩选举。

hanger
音标：英 /'hæŋə/  美 /'hæŋɚ/
n. 衣架；挂钩；绞刑执行者
短语：liner hanger — 衬管悬挂器
短语：clothes hanger — 挂衣服的架子；衣架（等于coat hanger）
短语：coat hanger — 衣架；挂衣钩
短语：hanger rod — 吊杆
短语：spring hanger — 弹簧吊架
例句：She took off her jacket and hung it on a hanger.
她脱下夹克挂在衣架上。

hangings
音标：美 /'hæŋɪŋ/
n. 门帘；脚手架；帘布（hanging的复数）
短语：hanging out — 挂出；常去（某处）
短语：hanging around — 无所事事
短语：hanging wall — 上盘；顶壁
短语：wall hanging — 壁挂，墙帷
短语：hanging basket — 挂篮；吊篮
短语：hanging up — 结束通话
短语：hanging garden — 悬园；空中花园
短语：hanging ring — 提手，吊环
短语：hanging bridge — 吊桥
短语：hanging lamp — 吊灯；挂灯
短语：hanging gardens of babylon — 空中花园（古巴比伦王国的世界七大奇观之一）
短语：hanging bracket — 吊架

hangman
音标：英 /'hæŋmən/  美 /'hæŋmən/
n. 刽子手；绞刑吏；执行绞刑者

hangnail
音标：英 /'hæŋneɪl/  美 /'hæŋ,nel/
n. 手指头的倒拉刺（指甲旁的逆刺皮）
例句：It's an environment that is at once trashy and highly exacting: every hangnail a sin, every eye-bag a crime.
环境就是这样的严格：每个手指倒刺都是过失，每个眼袋都是罪恶。

hangover
音标：英 /'hæŋəʊvə/  美 /'hæŋ'ovɚ/
n. 宿醉；残留物；遗物
例句：I had a terrible hangover the next day.
第二天我的宿醉反应很厉害。

hanker
音标：英 /'hæŋkə/  美 /'hæŋkɚ/
v. 向往，追求；渴望，期望
n. (Hanker)人名；(德、捷)汉克
例句：I hankered after a floor-length brown suede coat.
我渴望一件垂地长度的棕色麂皮大衣。

hankie
音标：英 /'hæŋkɪ/
n. 手帕（等于handkerchief）
例句：The Operatic Bow Same as above, only with a giant hankie in your right hand to wipe the sweat off your forehead after the exertion of returning to the vertical.
同上，只不过右手拿一个大手帕，努力站直的时候好擦前额的汗。 （译注：演完歌剧后要长时间谢幕。）
例句：Some try their best to comfort you, hand you a tissue or hankie, trying to soothe you with some soft words. But then there are some who will hold you and hug you.
一引起人尽量地安慰你，递给你一张纸巾或一块手帕，并且尽量和你说些宽慰的话。
例句：Is this mama's hankie?
这是妈妈的手帕吗？

haphazard
音标：英 /hæp'hæzəd/  美 /'hæphæzəd/
adj. 偶然的；随便的；无计划的
n. 偶然；偶然事件
adv. 偶然地；随意地
例句：Educational provision in the country is haphazard.
该国提供的教育毫无计划性。

hapless
音标：英 /'hæplɪs/  美 /'hæplis/
adj. 运气不好的，倒霉的
例句：The hapless passengers were stranded at the airport for three days.
倒霉的乘客在机场滞留了三天。

happen
音标：英 /'hæp(ə)n/  美 /'hæpən/
v. 发生；碰巧；偶然遇到
短语：happen to be — 碰巧是；恰巧是
短语：as it happens — 碰巧；偶然发生
短语：happen on — 偶然遇到或发现
短语：happen to meet — 偶然遇见
短语：happen to coincide — 不约而同；不谋而合
例句：When did the accident happen?
事故什么时候发生的？
例句：It’s impossible to predict what will happen next.
不可能预测接下来会发生什么。
例句：She carried on as if nothing had happened.
她继续干，似乎什么都未曾发生。
例句：This was bound to happen sooner or later.
这事注定早晚会发生。
例句：This kind of thing happens all the time.
这种事一直在发生。
例句：We’ll still be friends, whatever happens.
不管发生什么，我们仍然是朋友。
